# edstem-cli 0.4.0

- Rewrites the CLI in TypeScript 7 and publishes it through npm.
- Ships `edstem` and local stdio `edstem-mcp` executables from one package.
- Moves the hosted OAuth MCP runtime into the same repository while keeping its Bun and SQLite internals isolated.
- Uses one Ed client, parser, projection, and error model across all adapters.
- Makes compact list projections and `--fields` the default agent path.
- Preserves Markdown export, quiz submission, lesson progress, remote OAuth security, and reconnect behavior.
